bd4ebb3c39.q: What did General Motors and Cerber Solutions recover from their closed-loop battery recycling pilot?
bd4ebb3c39.a: General Motors and Cerber Solutions recovered 80 end-of-life battery packs, processed them into black mass, and created over 12 metric tons of new cathode active material. The nickel, cobalt, and manganese were entirely recycled and the material was validated to the same standards as new inputs. Ultium cells made the cells and GM assembled modules at Factory Zero and Spring Hill.
bd4ebb3c39.e: Automotive’s New Launchpad: Recycled Batteries, AI Drivers and the Workforce Ahead

fa13b8fd08.q: What new job titles are emerging in battery recycling and circular supply chain roles?
fa13b8fd08.a: New job titles emerging include battery lifecycle technician and circular supply chain analyst. Entry-level technicians need high-voltage safety, contamination control, and solid documentation skills. Advanced roles add black mass processing, analytical chemistry, and process controls.
fa13b8fd08.e: Automotive’s New Launchpad: Recycled Batteries, AI Drivers and the Workforce Ahead

0f7d753085.q: What production agreement did Mercedes and Wave sign for AI driver software?
0f7d753085.a: Mercedes and Wave signed a production agreement to bring Wave AI driver software to future vehicles targeting advanced urban and highway assistance within the next two years. The software is already integrated with Mercedes hardware and map interfaces, and they have done joint demos in three cities.
0f7d753085.e: Automotive’s New Launchpad: Recycled Batteries, AI Drivers and the Workforce Ahead

19eb92508c.q: What are Hyundai's plans for Atlas humanoid robot deployment in automotive manufacturing?
19eb92508c.a: Hyundai plans 25,000 Atlas deployments across its plants and a U.S. facility to produce 30,000 robots annually. The Boston Dynamics Robotics Metaplant Application Center uses real parts, fixtures, robots, and skilled pilots to generate behavior data as a permanent test bed, with component assembly targeted for 2030.

f79bf8a6d5.q: Which software platform did Coritura select as its foundational layer for commercial vehicles?
f79bf8a6d5.a: Coritura, founded by Daimler Truck and Volvo Group, picked AlloyCore as the foundational software layer for its commercial vehicle platform. AlloyCore is developed by Vector and QNX, and this is the platform's first announced design win.
f79bf8a6d5.e: Automotive’s New Launchpad: Recycled Batteries, AI Drivers and the Workforce Ahead

91b25f5d15.q: What cybersecurity regulations are being developed for vehicle software updates and lifecycle management?
91b25f5d15.a: The Unique Cyber and Software Update Group is working on R155 and R156 plus software identification standards for transformed vehicles. R155 focuses on cybersecurity management and R156 on software update management and traceability. ISO and SAE 21434 define lifecycle risk management requirements for road vehicle systems.
91b25f5d15.e: Automotive’s New Launchpad: Recycled Batteries, AI Drivers and the Workforce Ahead

dd6e7b0d96.q: What are the five distinct technical verticals that define the modern automotive workforce in 2026?
dd6e7b0d96.a: Modern automotive work spans five distinct technical verticals: electrochemistry and battery systems, autonomous driving and sensor fusion, smart factory automation, connected fleet data infrastructure, and cybersecurity and software compliance. These are converging into one workforce pipeline rather than remaining separate industries.
dd6e7b0d96.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

18d82d1e1f.q: What is the Washington Clean Energy Testbeds pouch cell laboratory and how does it address the lab-to-factory bottleneck?
18d82d1e1f.a: Washington Clean Energy Testbeds launched an open-access pouch cell laboratory on September 3rd that allows researchers and companies to build pilot batches of battery cells on demand using specialist equipment while retaining intellectual property. The facility produces standard pouch cells reaching 10 amp hours and includes hands-on technical college battery workshops with a graduate pathway in pouch cell fabrication training.
18d82d1e1f.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

287f26b5a6.q: What does the DOT Automated Vehicle National Strategy announced September 3rd specify about autonomous vehicle deployment and workforce roles?
287f26b5a6.a: The Automated Vehicle National Strategy covers fiscal years 2026 through 2030 and prioritizes safety, regulatory certainty, innovation and interoperable corridors. It provides guidance rather than immediate permission, anticipating human-driven and automated vehicles coexisting. Remote assistance teams become part of the safety architecture, requiring procedures, judgment, and incident documentation when automated vehicles encounter situations they cannot handle.
287f26b5a6.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

2d7956d584.q: What operational results did Hyundai achieve with Vision AI and manufacturing systems across its smart factories?
2d7956d584.a: Hyundai reports that Vision AI verifying vehicle identification numbers during production spans roughly 70 manufacturing processes across multiple regions, and another system optimizes parts cart routing using reinforcement learning. Unnecessary production downtime fell about 86% according to company-reported results, though replication depends on clean data, integration, governance, and maintenance.
2d7956d584.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

59373b32c4.q: How does the integration of Wyalon with High Mobility platform on September 1st change fleet data access across multiple automotive brands?
59373b32c4.a: Wyalon added OEM vehicle data through High Mobility platform, covering supported data from more than 20 automotive brands. High Mobility normalizes differing OEM data formats because each manufacturer structures data differently, allowing mixed fleets to combine manufacturer and aftermarket information without requiring additional trackers where OEM connectivity exists.
59373b32c4.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

8b0ef3aebe.q: What cybersecurity regulations are being addressed in the UNIC GRVA meeting September 14-18 regarding over-the-air vehicle software updates?
8b0ef3aebe.a: UNIC GRVA is addressing proposals for UN Regulations 155 and 156, which govern cybersecurity management systems and software update management systems respectively. One proposal links management system certificates with subsequent type approvals, and another addresses software identification across relevant regulations. These aim to ensure that governance follows vehicle software changes throughout the product lifecycle, not just at initial manufacture.
8b0ef3aebe.e: CARS ARE BECOMING SYSTEMS: How Software Is Rewriting the Auto Industry

f4a5405dc7.q: What is the Mitsui Kinzoku and Factorial Energy joint development agreement targeting for solid-state battery manufacturing?
f4a5405dc7.a: On September 18th, Mitsui Kinzoku announced a joint development agreement with Factorial Energy combining Mitsui Kinzoku's A-solid sulfide electrolyte with Factorial's Solstice cell development platform. The work focuses on electrolyte performance, layer-forming methods, manufacturing validation, and suitability for eventual mass production. However, this is a development agreement, not a production launch—the companies identify cell manufacturing processes and layer formation as technical work rather than solved problems.
f4a5405dc7.e: From Solid-State Batteries to Robot Factories: Five Automotive Breakthroughs Reshaping Skilled Work

b7dbb4b020.q: What did the U.S. Transportation Department's National Automated Vehicle Strategy for 2026-2030 specify about approved autonomous driving technology?
b7dbb4b020.a: The Transportation Department released its National Automated Vehicle Strategy on September 3rd organizing federal work around safety oversight, regulatory modernization, commercial deployment and interoperable corridors. NHTSA is developing objective performance standards for automated driving system competency, but the strategy does not endorse a particular mix of camera, radar, LIDAR, maps, or machine learning models. Engineers are responsible for demonstrating how their chosen architecture performs within its defined operating conditions.
b7dbb4b020.e: From Solid-State Batteries to Robot Factories: Five Automotive Breakthroughs Reshaping Skilled Work

d0d1c61691.q: What operational results did BMW report from its 10-month pilot with the Figure 2 robot at Spartanburg?
d0d1c61691.a: Over 10 months, the Figure 2 robot supported production of more than 30,000 BMW X3 vehicles. BMW reported more than 90,000 components moved, roughly 1,250 operating hours and about 1.2 million steps. The task involved retrieving and positioning sheet metal parts for welding with repeatable accuracy.
d0d1c61691.e: From Solid-State Batteries to Robot Factories: Five Automotive Breakthroughs Reshaping Skilled Work

a95b640970.q: What does BMW's Aeon Humanoid robot introduction at Plant Leipzig focus on?
a95b640970.a: BMW introduced Hexagon Robotics' wheeled Aeon Humanoid at Plant Leipzig, described as support for people, intended for repetitive work, material movement, high-voltage battery assembly, and selected component production tasks. BMW says the system is being introduced gradually so teams can identify useful applications and adapt workstations.
a95b640970.e: From Solid-State Batteries to Robot Factories: Five Automotive Breakthroughs Reshaping Skilled Work

3fd475722b.q: What growth rate did ChargePoint report for charging sessions versus vehicle adoption in 2025?
3fd475722b.a: ChargePoint released its 2026 Charging Forward Report on September 17th showing charging sessions on ChargePoint's network rose 34% in 2025, while vehicles on the road rose only 16%. The company also reported more than 1 million monthly drivers and said utilization outpaced port growth.

197e28d27a.q: What percentage of reported automotive cybersecurity incidents in 2025 originated from telematics and cloud according to Upstream's research?
197e28d27a.a: Upstream's researchers analyzed 494 publicly reported automotive and smart mobility cybersecurity incidents from 2025. Their 2026 report says ransom-related incidents represented 44% of that dataset and more than doubled from 2024. Additionally, 67% of reported incidents were attributed to telematics and cloud origins rather than physical vehicle hacking.
197e28d27a.e: From Solid-State Batteries to Robot Factories: Five Automotive Breakthroughs Reshaping Skilled Work
